===
Simple template
===
template integer t := 5;
---
(Root
  Nodes: (ModuleDef
    Def: (TemplateDecl TemplateTok: "template" AssignTok: ":="
      Type: (Ident "integer")
      Name: (Ident "t")
      Value: (ValueLiteral "5"))))

===
Template with omit restriction
===
template (omit) R t := omit;
---
(Root
  Nodes: (ModuleDef
    Def: (TemplateDecl TemplateTok: "template" Tok: "omit" AssignTok: ":="
      Type: (Ident "R")
      Name: (Ident "t")
      Value: (ValueLiteral "omit"))))

===
Lazy template
===
template @lazy integer t := f();
---
(Root
  Nodes: (ModuleDef
    Def: (TemplateDecl TemplateTok: "template" Modif: "@lazy" AssignTok: ":="
      Type: (Ident "integer")
      Name: (Ident "t")
      Value: (CallExpr
        Fun: (Ident "f")
        Args: (ParenExpr)))))

===
Parameterized template
===
template R t(integer a, template charstring b := ?) := { a := a, b := b };
---
(Root
  Nodes: (ModuleDef
    Def: (TemplateDecl TemplateTok: "template" AssignTok: ":="
      Type: (Ident "R")
      Name: (Ident "t")
      Params: (FormalPars
        List: (FormalPar
          Type: (Ident "integer")
          Name: (Ident "a"))
        List: (FormalPar AssignTok: ":="
          TemplateRestriction: (RestrictionSpec TemplateTok: "template")
          Type: (Ident "charstring")
          Name: (Ident "b")
          Value: (ValueLiteral "?")))
      Value: (CompositeLiteral
        List: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
          X: (Ident "a")
          Y: (Ident "a"))
        List: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
          X: (Ident "b")
          Y: (Ident "b"))))))

===
Superset and subset
===
template S t := { a := superset(1, 2), b := subset(3, 4) };
---
(Root
  Nodes: (ModuleDef
    Def: (TemplateDecl TemplateTok: "template" AssignTok: ":="
      Type: (Ident "S")
      Name: (Ident "t")
      Value: (CompositeLiteral
        List: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
          X: (Ident "a")
          Y: (CallExpr
            Fun: (Ident "superset")
            Args: (ParenExpr
              List: (ValueLiteral "1")
              List: (ValueLiteral "2"))))
        List: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
          X: (Ident "b")
          Y: (CallExpr
            Fun: (Ident "subset")
            Args: (ParenExpr
              List: (ValueLiteral "3")
              List: (ValueLiteral "4"))))))))

===
Decmatch
===

  Nodes: (ModuleDef
    Def: (TemplateDecl TemplateTok: "template" AssignTok: ":="
      Type: (Ident "octetstring")

===
Decmatch with encoding info
===

(Root
  Nodes: (ModuleDef
    Def: (TemplateDecl TemplateTok: "template" AssignTok: ":="
      Type: (Ident "octetstring")

        X: (BinaryExpr Op: ":"
          X: (Ident "MyType")
          Y: (CompositeLiteral
            List: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
              X: (Ident "a")
              Y: (ValueLiteral "1"))))))))

            List: (ValueLiteral "3")))))))

          Y: (ValueLiteral "\"x\""))
        List: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
          X: (Ident "c")
          Y: (CompositeLiteral
            List: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
              X: (Ident "d")
              Y: (ValueLiteral "true"))))))))

===
Var template with restriction
===
var template (omit) R vt := omit;
---
(Root
  Nodes: (ModuleDef
    Def: (ValueDecl KindTok: "var"
      TemplateRestriction: (RestrictionSpec TemplateTok: "template" Tok: "omit")
      Type: (Ident "R")
      Decls: (Declarator AssignTok: ":="
        Name: (Ident "vt")
        Value: (ValueLiteral "omit")))))

===

  Nodes: (ModuleDef
    Def: (ValueDecl KindTok: "var"

        Value: (ValueLiteral "1"))
      Decls: (Declarator AssignTok: ":="
        Name: (Ident "v2")
        Value: (ParenExpr
          List: (ValueLiteral "1")
          List: (ValueLiteral "2"))))))

===
Real-world: Receive template
===
template MsgType mw_msg(template integer p_id := ?) := {
  id := p_id,
  payload := pattern "OK*" ifpresent,
  options := superset(1, 2) length(2 .. 5)
}
---
(Root
  Nodes: (ModuleDef
    Def: (TemplateDecl TemplateTok: "template" AssignTok: ":="
      Type: (Ident "MsgType")
      Name: (Ident "mw_msg")
      Params: (FormalPars
        List: (FormalPar AssignTok: ":="
          TemplateRestriction: (RestrictionSpec TemplateTok: "template")
          Type: (Ident "integer")
          Name: (Ident "p_id")
          Value: (ValueLiteral "?")))
      Value: (CompositeLiteral
        List: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
          X: (Ident "id")
          Y: (Ident "p_id"))
        List: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
          X: (Ident "payload")
          Y: (UnaryExpr Op: "ifpresent"
            X: (PatternExpr Tok: "pattern"
              X: (ValueLiteral "\"OK*\""))))
        List: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
          X: (Ident "options")
          Y: (LengthExpr Len: "length"
            X: (CallExpr
              Fun: (Ident "superset")
              Args: (ParenExpr
                List: (ValueLiteral "1")
                List: (ValueLiteral "2")))
            Size: (ParenExpr
              List: (BinaryExpr Op: ".."
                X: (ValueLiteral "2")
                Y: (ValueLiteral "5")))))))))

===
Real-world: Modified template with nested fields
===
template (value) Header m_header modifies m_base := {
  version := 2,
  flags := { [0] := true, [1] := - }
}
---
(Root
  Nodes: (ModuleDef
    Def: (TemplateDecl TemplateTok: "template" Tok: "value" ModifiesTok: "modifies" AssignTok: ":="
      Type: (Ident "Header")
      Name: (Ident "m_header")
      Base: (Ident "m_base")
      Value: (CompositeLiteral
        List: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
          X: (Ident "version")
          Y: (ValueLiteral "2"))
        List: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
          X: (Ident "flags")
          Y: (CompositeLiteral
            List: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
              X: (IndexExpr
                Index: (ValueLiteral "0"))
              Y: (ValueLiteral "true"))
            List: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
              X: (IndexExpr
                Index: (ValueLiteral "1"))
              Y: (ValueLiteral "-"))))))))
